methodology.boundary: Page ready through a complete, enabled pre-submission form state; stopped before intake submission.
methodology.safety: Used established test phone and test-mode availability response. Created no intake, tentative appointment, Stripe action, or booking.
methodology.tokenMetric: Visible-text and full-DOM size estimates use ceil(characters / 4). The deterministic Playwright runner used no model inference.
methodology.caveat: The authoritative test-mode availability API returned zero openings, so the current waiting-list option was selected. This represents the site's valid pre-submission outcome for the shared scenario at run time.
